stem: The controller schedule says lights should be on, but the technician observes one zone dark. What is the strongest response?
choices: Change the crop photoperiod strategy independently
Record the schedule as though all lights were on
Ignore the zone because the controller is correct
Record intended photoperiod versus observed state and follow the supplied verification/escalation procedure
rationale: Record intended photoperiod versus observed state and follow the supplied verification/escalation procedure. This preserves the measurement, data-quality, record or role-boundary principle being assessed.
